title: SOAR NFL Wireless Charging Stand V.4, New Orleans Saints

comparisons.notes: Same SOAR NFL Saints stand, UPC match, in stock

writeup: This is the SOAR NFL wireless charging stand in New Orleans Saints styling, listed new at $14.14 on Amazon. Target sells the same stand for $34.99, so the price is about 59% lower. It props a Qi-compatible phone upright while it charges, which suits a desk or nightstand for Saints fans.
